vtopt/qnstop.manifest:
name = "qnstop"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "MIT"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
include-dir = ["src", "."]
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
implicit-typing = true
implicit-external = true
source-form = "default"
[preprocess.cpp]
suffixes = ["f95"]

scope: Serial QNSTOP for bound-constrained stochastic and global optimization. An FPM wrapper selects unmodified REAL_PRECISION, ZIGARRAY, QNSTOPS and bundled BLAS/LAPACK sources. Explicit CPP suffix handling lets FPM discover .f95 files. Legacy implicit typing/interfaces and argument-mismatch compatibility retain the upstream calling conventions. The seeded two-variable quadratic example checks normal stopping status, bounds, objective value and distance from its known minimizer. It is an accuracy smoke test, not a general global-optimum guarantee. The parallel QNSTOPP driver, noisy objectives, all stopping rules and performance are not validated.
